comparison.objective: Identify, flip, orient, and mount the correct wafer using tweezers.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate edge-only tweezer handling, bimanual handover, and planar alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Correct wafer face-down, centered and oriented, vacuum on, with tools and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Wafer identification and precision placement do not test coupled screw–locknut adjustment.
